dimension_justifications.soundness: The finite recorder-relative definition, selector domain, tie rule, half-step caveat, NFE arithmetic, dependence warning for rank-sum, probe exclusions, and non-mechanistic scope are stated precisely. However, the central numerical evidence remains source-reported and cannot be rebuilt from the submission; key event semantics, code, vectors, pairing, registration records, and checkpoint are absent.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The paper is unusually candid and many caveats occur near the relevant result. Nevertheless, the central identity is obscured by an exceptionally dense, qualification-heavy presentation: an audit of printed source summaries, a descriptive empirical case study, and a reporting recommendation are interleaved across the abstract, Sections 2--3, and appendices. Several tables compress materially different evidence strata and beds, making the headline support difficult to recover quickly.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The strongest supported contribution is a carefully bounded recorder-relative accounting of how the stated finite selector and active-block window can align with block length. It is a narrow descriptive audit, not independently verifiable empirical evidence or a causal/mechanistic finding; the reused development control and unavailable artifacts limit its decision-relevant significance.

paper_summary: This paper audits source-reported identity-lock profiles from a blockwise diffusion-LM case study. It formally defines a recorder-relative lock-time statistic and a finite-grid min--max period selector, reports that complete printed rows for L16/L64 and a reused L32 development control select their configured block lengths, excludes incomplete L24/L48 probes from the headline result, and argues for separating a-priori boundary-set reachability from measured magnitudes. It repeatedly limits all empirical claims to source-reported, locally unverifiable observations and disclaims mechanism.
strongest_verified_contribution: The manuscript itself permits verification of the finite-domain definitions, displayed NFE-48 arithmetic, candidate-set cardinalities, and that the printed Table 3 rows arithmetically select L for L16, L32 control, and L64 under Eq. (2). Its honest boundary is that the underlying empirical values cannot be verified here.
strengths: The title, abstract, Figure 1 caption, and Sections 2--3 consistently state that the object is recorder-relative and the intervention is partition-plus-required-allocation, not a causal model or sampler claim.
Identity-lock time, its finite observation domain, candidate boundary/interior sets, admissibility, and tie handling are explicitly defined in Section 2 (PDF pp. 3--4).
The paper clearly distinguishes the two main arms, reused L32/NFE48 development control, canvas-96 side probes, and separate L32/NFE32 content bed; Appendix C provides a useful terminology crosswalk.

Caveats are substantively placed near the relevant analyses: rank-sum dependence/calibration (p. 4), probe incompleteness (pp. 7--8), original-gate denominator mismatch (p. 13), spectral-family scope (pp. 11--12), and content-null granularity (pp. 14--15).

The PDF is anonymous on its title page, identifies conference review status, has no visible author identity in extracted text or metadata, and places the conclusion at the end of the nine-page main text before references and appendices. PDF metadata reports 17 letter pages, LaTeX/xdvipdfmx production, no JavaScript, and no custom metadata.
questions: Can the authors provide a reviewer-safe event/result bundle and analysis program sufficient to reconstruct Eq. (1), Table 3, the bootstrap criterion, and the rank-sum rows without exposing identities or the private checkpoint?

Can the paper state in one early boxed summary exactly which assertions are independently checkable from the submission, which are arithmetic checks of printed values, and which remain source reports?
Can Tables 1--6 label every bed directly in each relevant row/caption (rather than relying on nearby prose) and reserve the bare label “L32” only for an unambiguous arm?
Can the bibliography-wide citation metadata and local-support audit be completed, particularly for the broad background and scheduling statements in the introduction?

issues.location: PDF p. 2, Section 2 “Evidence status and paper identity”; pp. 3--4, identity-lock and bootstrap definitions; p. 6 Table 3; p. 12 Table 9; p. 15, Section B.
issues.observed_evidence: The paper explicitly says that the package lacks event streams, analysis programs, machine-readable results, complete registration records, and the checkpoint; no analysis was rerun. Table 9 likewise marks the principal evidence SR/CV. Thus the displayed values can be checked for internal arithmetic, but not traced to the stated recorder or recomputed.
issues.why_it_matters: The submission's core empirical identity is easy to misread as a new evidence audit of trajectories rather than an audit of a source report. The distinction is honestly disclosed, but the supplied material cannot establish that the reported profiles, bootstrap relations, or rank-sum ordering were produced by the defined measurement process.
issues.required_fix: Release a reviewer-safe reproducibility supplement with sanitized event-level or sufficient aggregate inputs, analysis code, deterministic environment/configuration, and result vectors; otherwise retitle and consistently foreground the work as an audit of printed source summaries rather than empirical evidence audit.
issues.verification_test: Using only the supplement and stated setup, independently reconstruct the inclusion rule for Eq. (1), m(r), d(r), all Table 3 candidate separations and argmaxes, and the supplied bootstrap/rank-sum summaries.
issues.evidence_needed: Machine-readable source profiles or event streams, event-schema contract, executable analysis, candidate score vectors, and bootstrap outputs/pairing information.

issues.location: PDF p. 1 abstract; p. 2, Section 2 “Evidence status and paper identity”; pp. 5--8, Sections 3.1--3.2; p. 9 conclusion; p. 12, Appendix A.6.
issues.observed_evidence: The manuscript alternates between three objects: arithmetic consistency of printed source rows, a source-reported recorder-relative result on two main arms plus reused control, and a general reporting recommendation. Repeated caveats are accurate but distributed across the abstract, design, results, limitations, conclusion, and evidence decomposition, while supporting side analyses are introduced in the main narrative.
issues.why_it_matters: A reader must synthesize numerous exclusions, evidence tiers, and non-claims before identifying the single conclusion. This makes the scope of the claimed contribution harder to evaluate than necessary and risks readers attributing more evidentiary force to tables/figures than the paper intends.
issues.required_fix: Add an early one-panel claim/evidence map that separates: checkable algebra/printed-row arithmetic; source-reported main-arm/control observations; excluded probe side observations; exploratory/supporting analyses; and the reporting recommendation. Then compress repeated caveats and move non-headline detail to appendices while retaining one local limitation per result.
issues.verification_test: A blinded reader should be able to state, after the abstract plus first two pages, the headline claim, the only three headline profiles, the reused-control status, and that neither the rank-sum nor L24/L48 supplies independent confirmation.
issues.evidence_needed: No new experiment is required for the organizational revision; a revised PDF and reader-comprehension check are sufficient.

issues.location: PDF p. 3 Table 1 and caption; p. 4 Table 2; p. 7 Tables 4--6; p. 17 Table 15.
issues.observed_evidence: Table 1 places four heterogeneous beds in a compact matrix and its caption uses the potentially ambiguous phrase “Those two arms form a separate canvas-96 setup.” Bare “L32” appears in several contexts, while Table 15 later distinguishes L32/NFE48 control from L32/NFE32 content bed. Table 2 further combines positivity, uncalibrated rank-sum, and an original three-bed wrong-candidate diagnostic in one table.
issues.why_it_matters: The table design forces the reader to resolve bed identity, evidence tier, and inferential status from surrounding prose. That is especially costly because the paper's central value is careful scope accounting.
issues.required_fix: Use explicit labels such as “L32/NFE48 reused control” and “L32/NFE32 content bed” in every table; separate configuration/evidence-tier information from inferential diagnostics; replace ambiguous caption antecedents with named probe arms.
issues.verification_test: Check that every numeric result table can be interpreted for canvas, NFE, arm status, evidence status, and headline/side-analysis status without consulting another page.
issues.evidence_needed: A revised table layout/caption set; no new empirical evidence.

issues.location: PDF p. 1 Introduction, citations in lines 32--39; p. 9 Section 5; p. 15 Table 12; included citation_lock.json.
issues.observed_evidence: The included citation lock verifies only three narrow conceptual-comparison entries and explicitly states that bibliography-wide metadata and sentence-level support auditing remains incomplete. The manuscript discloses this limitation in Section 5, but the broad diffusion/scheduling background citations in the introduction are not covered by the supplied reviewer-safe audit material.
issues.why_it_matters: The narrow novelty statement is responsible, but incomplete citation verification weakens readers' ability to assess the framing and whether closest related measurement work has been adequately positioned.
issues.required_fix: Complete a bibliography-wide metadata and local-claim support audit, or narrow the unverified background/positioning statements to claims that are explicitly supported by the supplied citation record.
issues.verification_test: For each citation-bearing factual or comparative sentence, provide verified metadata and a source-specific support note; confirm the closest-work table remains limited to supported comparisons.
issues.evidence_needed: Citation verification records for the full bibliography and sentence-level mapping.

ethics_concerns: No direct human-subject, harmful-deployment, or privacy claim is presented. The main responsible-research concern is epistemic: unavailable artifacts prevent independent validation, but the paper plainly discloses that limitation rather than presenting it as verified evidence.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control. The paper itself discloses AI-assisted language editing, LaTeX refactoring, internal review, and an image-generated qualitative Figure 1 (PDF p. 16); no generation record is provided for that figure, though its caption identifies it as schematic/non-quantitative.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A reviewer-safe artifact bundle that independently reconstructs the main-arm/control identity-lock profiles, selector outputs, and stability calculations.
A fresh preregistered L32/NFE48 control and a dual active/full-canvas recorder experiment on identical trajectories, if the paper seeks stronger empirical rather than source-audit claims.
A concise evidence-tier map and redesigned tables that make the central, checkable result immediately identifiable.
A complete citation-support audit for all framing and closest-work claims.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: A reconstruction showing that event-time semantics, terminal/missing handling, median convention, or selector implementation differs from the formal definitions.
Evidence that the reused L32 control is not comparable to the two main arms or that shared numeric bootstrap indices were interpreted as semantic pairing.
Recovery of the omitted L24/L48 vectors or original-gate grid that contradicts the stated exclusions/limitations.
A citation audit finding unsupported stronger priority, mechanism, or related-work statements.
review_limitations: I reviewed only the frozen submission files, as instructed; no source code, logs, prior rounds, external literature, or internet resources were inspected.

PDF review used text extraction and PDF metadata; I did not raster-inspect figures. Figure captions and extracted text support the stated qualitative/non-evidentiary role of Figure 1, but fine visual accessibility and graphical legibility were not independently assessed.
Because primary artifacts are absent by the submission's own disclosure, empirical correctness is classified as cannot_verify rather than asserted false.
